title: What going without food does
description:
Hour by hour: how your body switches from sugar to fat and ketones when you stop eating.
#fasting #metabolism #science #health
AI-free animation made with code. Not medical advice.

music.credit: Music: "Inspired" - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0

lines.hook: What happens if you stop eating for three days?
lines.b1: After twelve hours, your stomach can growl, and hunger comes in waves.
lines.b2: A day in, your stored sugar runs low, so your body burns fat.
lines.b3: By day two, you may feel tired, cranky, and a little dizzy.
lines.b4: By day three, ketones supply about a third of your brain's energy.
lines.end: What's the longest you've gone without food?
